ValidationRule.description: You can only mark as complete when the status is "Connected to INET".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Connected to INET")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only mark this stage complete when Status is "Connected to INET".
